notes.title: New Trailer Debut @ Top Hat Studios Showcase
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce that we've debuted a new trailer as part of our publisher's showcase. The trailer features an in depth look at gameplay and the many environments in the game, as well as teases other parts of the game's narrative. We'll have some more updates on the game's progress soon, including when to expect a release (and a demo)! In the meantime, we hope you enjoy.

[previewyoutube=pQId1ET6bKo;full][/previewyoutube]
